name: Living room
author: Eyad Sibai
description: Control the living-room TV and Sonos through the media command: TV power, Sonos volume, playback, scenes, remote, and casting local videos with subtitles and seeking.

barWidget.description: TV power, Sonos volume, playback and scenes. Scroll for Sonos volume, middle-click to mute, right-click to refresh.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often to ask the TV and Sonos for their state while the panel is closed. It refreshes every 5 seconds while open.

schema.label: Hide when away
schema.description: Hide the bar icon while neither the TV nor the Sonos answers, e.g. away from home.
